name: Redundant Constraint Elimination and Algebraic Simplification
description: I removed the redundant "harmonic buildup" cycle condition which inadvertently served as a massive semantic hint for bipartiteness (equal 1s and 2s in every cycle = even alternating cycles). I also replaced the specific 2x2 matrix trace condition with a much simpler singularity condition on a 3x3 matrix parameterized by the shift codes. The models now have to independently evaluate the determinant to discover the local $s_u \neq s_v$ edge constraint, and then independently realize this implies bipartiteness without the global cycle hint.
